::: {.cheat title="Mermaid zoomable? Diagran: flowchart TD (1.1)" column="1"}
```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 2 
%%| fig-height: 1.3
flowchart TD
    
    A{"Iris Setosa (35/105)"}
    B{"Iris-setosa (35/35)"}
    C{"Iris-versicolor (35/70)"}
    D{"Iris-versicolor (34/39)"}
    E{"Iris-virginica (30/31)"}
    F{"Iris-versicolor (32/33)"}
    G{"Iris-virginica (4/6)"}
    
    
    A -->|petalWidth <=0.8| B
    A -->|petalWidth >0.8| C
    
    C -->|petalWidth <=1.75| D
    C -->|petalWidth >1.75| E
    
    
    D -->|petalLength <=4.95| F
    D -->|petalLength >4.95| G
    
```
:::

::: {.cheat title="Mermaid Diagran: flowchart LR (1.1)" column="1"}
```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 2 
%%| fig-height: 1.3
flowchart LR
    
    A{"Iris Setosa (35/105)"}
    B{"Iris-setosa (35/35)"}
    C{"Iris-versicolor (35/70)"}
    D{"Iris-versicolor (34/39)"}
    E{"Iris-virginica (30/31)"}
    F{"Iris-versicolor (32/33)"}
    G{"Iris-virginica (4/6)"}
    
    
    A -->|petalWidth <=0.8| B
    A -->|petalWidth >0.8| C
    
    C -->|petalWidth <=1.75| D
    C -->|petalWidth >1.75| E
    
    
    D -->|petalLength <=4.95| F
    D -->|petalLength >4.95| G
    
```
:::


::: {.cheat title='Mermaid: Sequence diagram' column=1 .color-  colframe=''}

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 2.5
sequenceDiagram
  participant Alice
  participant Bob
  Alice->>John: Hello John, how are you?
  loop Healthcheck
    John->>John: Fight against hypochondria
  end
  Note right of John: Rational thoughts <br/>prevail!
  John-->>Alice: Great!
  John->>Bob: How about you?
  Bob-->>John: Jolly good!
```
:::
